title: MusicDrop v1.5.6 Available
changelog:
• Fixed Device Tab Layout & Chips: Made category filter pills smoothly scrollable with no text wrapping or squishing
• Light Theme Contrast Fix: All device media rows, headers, and counts now dynamically use high-contrast theme colors (no more faint white-on-white text)
• Smart Sleep Timer: Added 'End of current song' mode so playback stops right when your current song finishes
• Interactive Queue Reordering: Move Up and Move Down buttons directly on Up Next queue items to easily promote and arrange upcoming tracks
• Stream & Media Cache Manager: One-tap 'Clear Cache' in Settings with real-time size calculation while keeping downloaded music safe
